The task succeeded after the caregiver emphasized proper tool selection and task scope.

They failed to wash the apple before slicing it and did not preheat the oven, resulting in an undercooked pie that was not safely prepared. The caregiver emphasized the importance of washing produce, properly unrolling the crust into the pie dish, preheating the oven to ensure even baking, and cooling the finished pie on the wire rack; however, the task failed due to repeated errors in following the sequence and safety steps.
  3. The task was to sweep the living room floor, a level-1 cleaning task, using a broom and dustpan. The child initially hesitated on the sweeping direction and dustpan placement but correctly used the broom to gather debris and the dustpan to collect it after caregiver guidance to start from the edges and sweep toward the center where the dustpan was positioned. The task succeeded.
